comparison.objective: Install a rack rail versus apply paint along trim with an edge-guided tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Prong insertion, leveling, telescoping and fastening versus surface contact, wheel guidance and controlled coating.
comparison.success_condition: Correct rack-unit retention and screw-hole use versus coverage and cut-line percentages, zero trim paint and tool return.
